name: Michael Nicholas Kulp
notable_stories: Michael Nicholas Kulp and three of his brothers were in the Civil War from 1861-1863, PA Bucktail Regiment of sharpshooters
Sarah Kulp went to Illinois to be near her parents the Vancels while John was in the war
John Jacob Kulp was their first child
milestones: Buried at Orting, WA Soldiers Home Cemetery
Served in PA Bucktail Regiment, Civil War 1861-1863
notes: Father of John Jacob Kulp. Son of Henry Kolb. Also spelled Culp.
